name: v2.32.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Write the log file as UTF-8 by @pcbeingused333 in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2448
* Substitute favorite query args $10 and above by @zzoraemon043 in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2449
* fix: replace undecodable bytes in /system command output by @pcbeingused333 in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2450
* Add guidance on changelog entry length by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2451
* Quote identifiers in sql-insert and sql-update output by @zzoraemon043 in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2452
* Refine `under_words` completions method by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2453
* Prepare changelog for release v2.32.0 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2454

## New Contributors
* @zzoraemon043 made their first contribution in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2449

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/compare/v2.31.1...v2.32.0
